questions: Are consecutive delimiters (e.g., multiple commas or spaces) treated as a single delimiter, or do they produce empty strings in the output?
Should leading/trailing delimiters be ignored (trimmed) or produce empty strings?
Are delimiters only commas and spaces, or could tabs, newlines, or other whitespace also be considered standard?
Should punctuation other than commas (like periods, semicolons) be treated as delimiters or part of words?
Is the output order required to match the left-to-right appearance of words in the input?
Should words be stripped of surrounding whitespace after splitting, or retain internal spaces?
Are empty strings (from input like only delimiters) expected to return an empty list or list with empty strings?
If a word contains a comma inside (e.g., quoted or escaped), should it be split or kept whole?
